fieldNotes.location: Supplied coords (34.055371,-117.727269) are a misgeocode: Google resolves '1450 E Mission Blvd' to Pomona CA 91766 (a retail strip, confirmed via Street View) because Mission Blvd straddles Pomona/Ontario. The actual operational NFI Inland Empire DC reverse-geocodes to 1990 S Cucamonga Ave, Ontario CA 91761 (cross street E Francis St). Confirmed NFI via NFI-branded tractors at the gate in Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entrance off E Francis St at the building's NW: z21 satellite shows a barrier line across the drive throat with a small gatehouse island; Street View shows the entry median with signage and NFI tractors queued.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white ~1-vehicle-footprint booth sitting on a median island in the middle of the entry drive (z21), lanes split around it.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single gate throat at NW; lanes split around the booth island for in/out at one point.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock line along the entire ~345m west wall with trailers backed in at regular spacing; far exceeds 50 — banded 50+. Exact count uncertain from overhead.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer-storage strip west of the dock apron holds bobtail trailers; estimated 25-50.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court inside the gate before the dock line provides queue/staging room.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the line near the south road is curb/drainage, not track.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 13.7 ac from traced perimeter (building + east landscape buffer to Cucamonga + west truck court/drop yard). Note the D&B record's 10.76 ac / 168,361 sqft belongs to the separate '1450 E Mission' corporate listing; the operational DC building footprint here is ~560k sqft.
